subject: *: fix 'Duplicate entry' error when @@auto_increment_increment and @@auto_increment_offset is set (#52626)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff (vs first parent) for executor/table behavior: auto_increment allocation now normalizes (increment,offset) so that when offset > increment the offset is effectively ignored (set to 1), matching MySQL behavior and preventing invalid (increment,offset) combinations from driving ID allocation. Also reviewed the related autoid_service state init/rebase hardening that affects AUTO_ID_CACHE=1 allocation paths. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, data consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or session/transaction behavior for the touched areas.
